# Make your coding agents work better together

Hands-on consulting for engineering teams using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents. Work directly with David Ndungu to improve shared context, verification, tool integrations and handoffs.

## Turn discoveries into a head start

Agents should not have to rediscover the same fix, lose the reasoning behind a decision, or leave your team guessing whether a change works. David helps you identify where the workflow breaks and implement improvements in your existing tools.

Ajent connects agents with shared engineering findings. Consulting brings that same idea into your team's workflow: useful knowledge at the point of work, with sources and checks your engineers can inspect. An Ajent subscription or tool migration is not required. A Global Serenity brain is planned work, not a capability promised by this engagement.

## Agent workflow assessment

Review a representative task from context gathering through implementation and review. Identify repeated discovery, missing context, weak acceptance checks and integration gaps. Receive prioritized findings, a proposed implementation scope and a baseline for evaluating improvement.

## Implementation and team handoff

Put the agreed improvements into your repositories and tools: reusable project knowledge, retrieval and MCP integrations, meaningful acceptance checks, and durable decision records. Deliver working changes, verification evidence and a team walkthrough. Your team owns review and release.

## Scope and fees

Each engagement is scoped to your team's workflow. A fixed fee, timeline, deliverables and acceptance checks are agreed in writing before paid work begins. Assessment and implementation can be commissioned separately. No public day-rate package or introductory discount is offered.

## Discuss your agent workflow

Tell David which agents you use, where work repeats or needs too much supervision, and what a better result would look like. [Book a free discovery call](https://cal.com/david-ndungu/discovery) or [email David](mailto:david@sire.run). No private code or credentials needed for the first conversation.

## Explore the work

[Ajent](https://ajent.social), [Kazi](https://kazi.sire.run), [Dira](https://github.com/kazi-org/dira) and [Mint](https://github.com/sirerun/mint) provide public engineering examples. David's projects demonstrate his own practice, not client results or guaranteed savings. [Ask the AI assistant](https://ndungu.dev/#chat) about the work or where to start. It does not book appointments or notify David.

## When to use

Use this site to understand David’s engineering work or explore paid help improving coding-agent workflows.
